title: PrivacyComm
description:
PrivacyComm addresses the need for secure and private messaging at an affordable cost. By integrating L2 rollups like Arbitrum and privacy-focused L2s like Scroll, the app enables users to communicate confidentially on a testnet. This innovative solution not only ensures the security of messages but also provides a cost-effective alternative that was previously unavailable.

**Links**
- [https://github.com/technicalkuldeep/ethindia](https://github.com/technicalkuldeep/ethindia)
how_its_made: During the development of PrivacyComm, we encountered a challenge in optimizing the integration of Scroll for secure message transmission. Fine-tuning the interaction between Scroll and Arbitrum to achieve seamless and cost-effective messaging posed a specific hurdle. Through rigorous testing and collaboration with the development community, we successfully overcame these challenges, ensuring a robust and reliable platform.
